name: association-tresorerie
description: MVP de trésorerie pour association bénévole

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.check: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend run check && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.seed:demo: docker compose exec -T database psql -U tresorerie -d tresorerie < backend/sql/002_demo_seed.sql
scripts.db:demo: docker compose exec -T database psql -U tresorerie -d tresorerie < backend/sql/002_demo_seed.sql
